# System Architecture Blueprint: CodeMachine Landing Page

**Version:** 1.0
**Date:** 2025-11-22
**Generated By:** Structural_Data_Architect

<!-- anchor: 1-0-introduction-goals -->
## 1. Introduction & Goals

*   **1.1. Project Vision:** Deliver a premium Aura-style, dark-mode landing page that communicates the CodeMachine CLI orchestration engine, showcases social proof, and drives visitors toward documentation and npm installation.
*   **1.2. Key Objectives:**
    - Represent the CLI-native workflow through interactive hero, bento grid, and simulation modules that align with the glassmorphism specification.
    - Provide deterministic copy-to-clipboard, GitHub star telemetry, and documentation routing directly from the static React app.
    - Preserve rapid iteration by storing all page content, links, and feature toggles in typed configuration files consumed at build time.
    - Ensure accessibility, responsive layouts, and reliable fallbacks for mobile and offline-friendly states.
*   **1.3. Scope:** Covers the static React single-page experience, content configuration, visual assets, clipboard + GitHub integrations, and documentation/source-code links served via CDN. Excludes any backend authoring tool, marketing automation, or authentication.
*   **1.4. Key Assumptions:** Animations default to IntersectionObserver + CSS unless future work elevates to GSAP; GitHub API may run without authentication but supports optional tokens with six-hour caching; on mobile, the visual simulation collapses to a simplified card to protect performance.

<!-- anchor: 2-0-architectural-drivers -->
## 2. Architectural Drivers

*   **2.1. Functional Requirements Summary:** Hero section with copyable install command, docs CTA, and ambient hero animation; GitHub star badge with graceful fallback; feature bento grid with hover glows; glassmorphic terminal simulation; docs and GitHub navigation; clipboard failure mitigation.
*   **2.2. Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs):** Strict Aura theme fidelity, glassmorphism layers, and noise textures; responsive stacking below `md`; accessibility (focus-visible, aria-live copy toast); performance budget under 200KB gzipped via tree-shaken icons and deferred animations; observability through structured console logs and optional analytics helper.
*   **2.3. Constraints & Preferences:** Architectural style fixed to Static Single-Page Application delivered via CDN; React 18 with Vite tooling, Tailwind CSS Aura tokens, Lucide icons, GSAP/IntersectionObserver for scroll reveals, and browser-only clipboard logic; no server-side rendering or databases; deployable on Netlify or Vercel with optional Docker for parity.

<!-- anchor: 3-0-proposed-architecture -->
## 3. Proposed Architecture (Structural View)

<!-- anchor: 3-1-architectural-style -->
### 3.1. Architectural Style

Static Single-Page Application delivered through a CDN edge, aligning with the foundation directive for small-scale marketing surfaces. The React 18 + Vite bundle hosts all deterministic content, while lightweight client hooks progressively enhance clipboard, GitHub fetch, and scroll-triggered reveals without introducing backends.

<!-- anchor: 3-2-technology-stack -->
### 3.2. Technology Stack Summary

| Layer | Technology & Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Frontend Runtime | React 18 rendered in the browser as a Vite-built SPA with hydration-free static delivery. |
| Build Tooling | Vite + pnpm for bundling, plus Docker (node:20-alpine) for reproducible CI builds. |
| Styling System | Tailwind CSS with Aura theme extensions (Inter + JetBrains Mono fonts, glass-card utilities, noise/glow assets). |
| Icons & Assets | Lucide icon bundle, SVGO-optimized noise texture, ambient glow gradients, linear grid backgrounds. |
| Animation Layer | Native IntersectionObserver with optional GSAP or Framer Motion micro-reveals triggered post-idle. |
| Data Sources | Local TypeScript config modules for Hero/Feature/Link content; browser fetch to GitHub REST v3 for star count. |
| Hosting & CDN | Netlify or Vercel static hosting with edge caching and env var support for GitHub token throttling. |
| Observability | Console.info/warn logs plus optional PostHog `trackEvent` helper invoked from shared utility. |

<!-- anchor: 3-3-system-context -->
### 3.3. System Context Diagram (C4 Level 1)

*   **Description:** Senior developers, DevOps engineers, and AI engineers access the CodeMachine Landing Page to evaluate the CLI. The SPA serves deterministic content, links out to the docs portal, fetches GitHub stars for social proof, and optionally emits analytics events.
*   **Diagram (PlantUML):**
    ~~~plantuml
    @startuml
    !include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Context.puml

    LAYOUT_WITH_LEGEND()

    Person(dev, "Senior Engineer", "Evaluates CLI workflows and documentation")
    System(spa, "CodeMachine Landing Page", "Aura-themed React SPA served via CDN")
    System_Ext(docs, "CodeMachine Docs", "docs.codemachine.co static portal")
    System_Ext(github, "GitHub REST API", "moazbuilds/CodeMachine-CLI repo stats")
    System_Ext(analytics, "Analytics Endpoint", "PostHog or lightweight tracking collector")

    Rel(dev, spa, "Consumes content, copies CLI commands", "HTTPS")
    Rel(spa, docs, "Deep-link to documentation", "Target=_blank, rel=noopener")
    Rel(dev, docs, "Reads full docs", "New tab")
    Rel(spa, github, "GET star count", "Fetch + optional token")
    Rel(spa, analytics, "trackEvent()", "POST JSON")
    Rel(github, dev, "Displays repo trust cues", "Star badge")

    @enduml
    ~~~

<!-- anchor: 3-4-container-diagram -->
### 3.4. Container Diagram (C4 Level 2)

*   **Description:** The solution boundary contains the React SPA, its typed content module, and GitHub integration component. External containers consist of the CDN edge, GitHub API, docs portal, and analytics endpoints. Relationships highlight asset delivery, data sourcing, and external navigation obligations.
*   **Diagram (PlantUML):**
    ~~~plantuml
    @startuml
    !include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Container.puml

    Person(dev, "Power User", "Senior Dev/DevOps/AI engineer")

    System_Boundary(codemachine, "CodeMachine Landing Page") {
        Container(browserSPA, "React SPA", "React 18 + Vite + Tailwind", "Renders hero, simulation, features, footer")
        Container(uiConfig, "Content Config Module", "TypeScript modules", "Exports HeroContent, FeatureCard, ExternalLink, FeatureFlag objects")
        Container(intStatus, "Integration Status Bar", "React hook + fetch", "Retrieves GitHub stars, caches & falls back")
    }

    Container_Ext(cdn, "Global CDN Edge", "Netlify/Vercel", "Serves static assets and enforces edge caching")
    Container_Ext(github, "GitHub REST API", "Stars endpoint", "Repository metadata")
    Container_Ext(docs, "Docs Portal", "Static docs", "Documentation site")
    Container_Ext(analytics, "Analytics Endpoint", "PostHog/lightweight collector", "Optional structured events")

    Rel(dev, browserSPA, "Visits, scrolls, copies commands", "HTTPS")
    Rel(browserSPA, cdn, "Requests HTML/JS/CSS", "Edge cached static assets")
    Rel(browserSPA, uiConfig, "Imports typed content & flags", "ES modules")
    Rel(browserSPA, intStatus, "Displays dynamic star badge", "Props/hooks")
    Rel(intStatus, github, "Fetch star count with retry", "REST GET")
    Rel(browserSPA, docs, "Opens docs link", "New tab")
    Rel(browserSPA, analytics, "trackEvent + console info", "POST JSON")

    @enduml
    ~~~

<!-- anchor: 3-5-component-diagram -->
### 3.5. Component Diagram (C4 Level 3 - React SPA)

*   **Description:** The React SPA container decomposes into layout, view, utility, and integration components defined inside the foundation. Each component consumes typed data and shared tokens to guarantee alignment with visual and data contracts.
*   **Diagram (PlantUML):**
    ~~~plantuml
    @startuml
    !include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Component.puml

    Container_Boundary(spa, "React SPA") {
        Component(experienceShell, "ExperienceShell", "React Layout", "Applies Aura backgrounds, navigation, and scroll orchestration")
        Component(contentConfig, "ContentConfigModule", "TypeScript config", "Exports HeroContent, FeatureCard, ExternalLink, FeatureFlag data")
        Component(heroPanel, "HeroCommandPanel", "React Component", "Hero copy, CLI command, copy button + analytics")
        Component(visualSim, "VisualSimulationWindow", "React Component", "Glassmorphic terminal simulation with mobile fallback")
        Component(bentoGrid, "FeatureBentoGrid", "React Component", "Responsive bento layout with hover glows")
        Component(integrationBar, "IntegrationStatusBar", "React Component", "Fetches GitHub stars, caches response, renders fallback")
        Component(featureFlagGate, "FeatureFlagGate", "Utility", "Wraps experimental UI toggles via flags.ts")
        Component(observability, "ObservabilityHooks", "Utility", "Structured console logging and optional trackEvent helper")
    }

    Rel(experienceShell, contentConfig, "Imports typed assets and theme tokens")
    Rel(experienceShell, heroPanel, "Passes HeroContent props")
    Rel(experienceShell, visualSim, "Places simulation + responsive behavior")
    Rel(experienceShell, bentoGrid, "Supplies FeatureCard array for grid")
    Rel(experienceShell, integrationBar, "Renders star badge in nav/footer")
    Rel(heroPanel, observability, "Log copy success/failure + fallbacks")
    Rel(heroPanel, featureFlagGate, "Respect CTA experiments")
    Rel(integrationBar, observability, "Log fetch + fallback outcomes")
    Rel(integrationBar, featureFlagGate, "Enable alternate metrics UI")
    Rel(bentoGrid, contentConfig, "Consumes feature definitions")
    Rel(visualSim, contentConfig, "Reads textual labels & animation toggles")

    @enduml
    ~~~

<!-- anchor: 3-6-data-model -->
### 3.6. Data Model Overview & ERD

*   **Description:** Typed configuration modules encode the deterministic marketing content while lightweight runtime metrics capture GitHub star counts. Each entity aligns with the foundation contracts, enabling consistent rendering, fallbacks, and experimentation.
*   **Key Entities:** HeroContent (headlines, install/start commands, CTA link), FeatureCard (title, description, icon, grid span, accent glow), ExternalLink (label, URL, icon, nav location, `newTab` flag), StarMetric (label, count, timestamp, fallback copy), VisualAsset (noise/glow definitions), FeatureFlag (boolean toggles for experiments), and the ContentConfigModule that binds them.
*   **Diagram (PlantUML - ERD):**
    ~~~plantuml
    @startuml
    hide circle

    entity ContentConfigModule {
        * id : string <<PK>>
        --
        version : string
        env : string
    }

    entity HeroContent {
        * headline : string
        subheadline : string
        install_command : string
        start_command : string
        beta_label : string
        cta_link : url
    }

    entity FeatureCard {
        * id : string <<PK>>
        title : string
        description : string
        icon : string
        grid_span : string
        accentGlow : string
    }

    entity ExternalLink {
        * id : string <<PK>>
        label : string
        url : url
        icon : string
        location : string
        newTab : boolean
    }

    entity StarMetric {
        * label : string <<PK>>
        count : number
        timestamp : datetime
        fallbackCopy : string
        cacheTTLHours : number
    }

    entity VisualAsset {
        * id : string <<PK>>
        type : enum
        opacity : number
        blendMode : string
        zIndex : number
    }

    entity FeatureFlag {
        * key : string <<PK>>
        description : string
        enabled : boolean
        defaultState : boolean
    }

    ContentConfigModule ||--|| HeroContent : "owns"
    ContentConfigModule ||--o{ FeatureCard : "lists"
    ContentConfigModule ||--o{ ExternalLink : "navigation"
    ContentConfigModule ||--o{ VisualAsset : "background layers"
    ContentConfigModule ||--o{ FeatureFlag : "defines"
    HeroContent ||--|| StarMetric : "references GitHub badge copy"
    ExternalLink ||--|| StarMetric : "annotates GitHub CTA"
    FeatureFlag ||--o{ FeatureCard : "enables variations"

    @enduml
    ~~~
